theorems.name: Submission.bf_sphere_ae_slabGood
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ H : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ a : Rn (n + ℓ), μHE[n] {θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ ¬ ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖H.starProjection (x - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (x - a)) θ • θ‖ < s * ‖H.starProjection (x - a)‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∨ (∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖H.starProjection (x - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (x - a)) θ • θ‖ < s * ‖H.starProjection (x - a)‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r))) ∨ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ a ∧ dist b a < δ ∧ H.starProjection (b - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (b - a)) θ • θ = 0)} = 0
